what_changed: No new print (Q4-2026 reports in late January). This round fixes every period the carry-forward check found, installs the depreciation rebuild, and fixes the 35 paths the first gate round failed. (1) Impressions: each quarter was the same quarter a year earlier times a kept growth rate; now daily users (Meta adding ~0.025B a quarter, about 40% of the world's new internet users per ITU) times impressions per user (+5% in Q4-26 and 2027, +4.5% in 2028, +4% in 2029). (2) Q4-2026: ads = impressions +7.5% x price per ad +16% = $72.5B; other revenue = WhatsApp messaging +50% plus ~$90M of Meta One = $1.29B; Q4 revenue $74.8B, inside the $73-76B guide. (3) Ad revenue 2027-29 now grows with the social ad market at a constant Meta share (WARC +14.6% 2027, +10.6% 2028; Omdia +12% 2029) instead of the base round's price-per-ad steps: ads $286.4B / $316.8B / $354.8B. This is the largest cut. (4) Capex was a ratio path; now the post-print analyst estimates: FY2026 $140B (guide midpoint, declared), FY2027 $241B (mean of Wedbush $249B, Wells Fargo ~$250B, Morgan Stanley $225B), FY2028 $250B (Morgan Stanley), FY2029 $250B plateau (Jefferies). (5) D&A: the fitted x0.85 lag and x1.044 scale are replaced by the depreciation engine, fitted to the filed CIP balances ($26.8B Dec-2024 to $89.5B Sep-2026) and filed server depreciation: buildings 25 years (10-K 25-30; the 11-17 audit's ~10 years was a fitting artifact), servers ~3 quarters in CIP then 5.5 years. On the new capex D&A is $44.1B / $72.4B / $104.3B for FY2027-29. (6) Net interest from a net debt roll at 4.5% on the set's own cash flows: $4.7B (Nov-Dec 2027 rate) / $7.5B / $12.3B; FY2029 preferred dividends $508M (converts 2029-08-15) and FY2029 shares 2,620.2M. (7) Reality Labs: the FY2026 loss is the residual of the expense guide and FY2027 'around $15B' stays a declared guide use; the rl_rev constant is now a labelled judgment. (8) The gate also corrected three claims about the Q3 call (no new Muse or Threads ad inventory named; the engagement doubling was Meta AI per person; no 2027 budget described). Guide used as a last resort on 4 items (FY2026 expenses, FY2026 capex, its Q4 residual, FY2027 Reality Labs). Net: research target (12m) 654.27 -> 530.61 (-18.9%).
